_notes: What UQM 0.8.0's own lander draws, frame by frame, recorded as lander-hazards.json is (and with its masks) with the drawing recorded: each frame adds two lists after the explosion, what was drawn on the surface view (PlanetContext: ScrollPlanetSide's map, DrawBatch's display list from its head, the lander, its shadow and shield, the mineral text) and in the lander's gauges (RadarContext: InitLander before the landing, as PickPlanetSide calls it, then AnimateLanderWarmup, DeltaLanderCrew and FillLanderHold), in order. Each is ["m", x, y] the planet's map, ["s", sheet, frame, x, y] a stamp, ["f", sheet, frame, x, y, r, g, b] a filled stamp, ["r", x, y, width, height, r, g, b] a filled rectangle, or ["t", x, y, align, text, characters (-1 all), r, g, b] text (the game's strings are empty here; the amount is code). Sheets as in lander.json. Code and the masks' shapes; no content.
Landings from lander-pickups.json, lander-creatures.json and lander-hazards.json, cut to their first few hundred frames.
